name.description: Archicad undo-step name; defaults to 'EvP command'.

steps.description: Transaction steps as JSON strings, replayed in array order inside one undo scope. Each string encodes command, params, bindings, and bindingCount. Each binding string uses step plus dotted source key and dotted target path; values may be booleans, integers, numbers, strings, or complete nested objects.

results.description: Per-step successful response objects serialized as JSON strings, positionally aligned with the input steps.

vertexCounts.description: Vertex count per convex sub-polygon; splits vertexIndices.

vertexIndices.description: Packed 1-based body-local vertex indices split by vertexCounts.

vertices.description: Packed xyz vertices; stride 3 in 1-based body-local vertex order.

vectors.description: Packed xyz vector pool; stride 3; signed polygon normalIndex addresses this 1-based pool.

transform.description: Packed row-major API_Tranmat 3x4 affine matrix; 12 numbers.

polygons.description: Packed polygon structure-of-arrays in 1-based body-local order; firstPolyEdge/lastPolyEdge address polyEdges.

polyEdges.description: Packed signed edge indices; zero is a contour break and all other values address the 1-based edge pool.

edges.description: Packed edge structure-of-arrays in 1-based body-local order.

vertices.description: Packed xyz coordinates; stride 3, ModelerAPI vertex order, 1-based topology indices.

normals.description: Packed xyz normal-vector pool; stride 3; signed polygon indices address this 1-based pool.

edges.description: Packed structure-of-arrays edge topology. Every field has count entries and indices are 1-based; polygon -1 means absent.

polygons.description: Packed structure-of-arrays polygon topology. edgeCounts splits vertexIndices and signed edgeIndices; zero edge index is a contour break.

convex.description: Packed convex pieces. vertexCounts splits vertexIndices; normals are packed xyz per corner (stride 3).

coords.description: Packed world xyz polygon coordinates; stride 3 in API polygon order.

paramsJson.description: Current palette parameter values serialized as a JSON object; empty when no palette is available.

contourVertexCounts.description: Vertex count for each contour; first contour is outer and the rest are holes; splits uv and coords.

uv.description: Packed cut-plane uv coordinates; stride 2 and split by contourVertexCounts.

coords.description: Packed world xyz coordinates; stride 3 and split by contourVertexCounts.

limit.description: Maximum number of recent failure entries to return; defaults to 10. Zero returns no entries.

entries.description: Recent native failure summaries, oldest first.

total.description: Failures reported since the add-on loaded.

logPath.description: Path to the full native API error log, or an empty string when unavailable.

transform.description: Packed row-major 3x4 local-to-world affine matrix; 12 numbers.

vertices.description: Packed NURBS vertex structure-of-arrays; coords use xyz stride 3 and all arrays follow 1-based vertex order.

edges.description: Packed NURBS edge structure-of-arrays. trimCounts splits trimIndices; topology values retain the API pool index conventions.

trims.description: Packed NURBS trim structure-of-arrays in 1-based trim order.

loops.description: Packed loop topology; trimCounts splits trimIndices and trimReversed.

faces.description: Packed face topology; loopCounts splits loopIndices.

shells.description: Packed shell topology; faceCounts splits faceIndices and faceReversed.

lumps.description: Packed lump topology; shellCounts splits shellIndices.

controlPoints.description: Packed xyz control grid; stride 3, u outer and v inner.

weights.description: Packed row-major weight grid; u outer and v inner.

transform.description: Packed row-major point-cloud data-to-target 4x4 matrix; 16 numbers.

u.description: Packed U coordinates aligned with v and input points.

v.description: Packed V coordinates aligned with u and input points.

u.description: Packed U coordinates positionally aligned with v and input points.

v.description: Packed V coordinates positionally aligned with u and input points.

pixels.description: Packed ARGB bytes in top-to-bottom row-major order; stride 4 per pixel.

shown.description: False when hiding the prompt was accepted for asynchronous dispatch.

screen.description: Pixel results positionally aligned with input points.

coord.description: Drawing-space results positionally aligned with input points.

reason.description: Human-readable cancellation reason, or an empty string when not cancelled.

polygon.description: Packed XY polygon coordinates with stride 2 and at least three points.

guids.description: Packed element identity correspondence: GUID per hit index.

elemTypes.description: ModelerAPI element type per hit index.

points.description: Packed hit XYZ coordinates: stride 3 in hit-index order.

normals.description: Packed normal XYZ vectors: stride 3 in hit-index order.

origins.description: Packed ray origins with XYZ stride 3.

directions.description: Packed ray directions with XYZ stride 3; length equals origins.

hitCounts.description: Hit count per ray; sum(values) defines all hit-array lengths.

t.description: Hit distances concatenated in ray order.

enter.description: Solid-entry flags in concatenated hit order.

guids.description: Packed element identity correspondence: GUIDs in concatenated hit order.

points.description: Packed hit XYZ coordinates: stride 3 in concatenated hit order.

normals.description: Packed normal XYZ vectors: stride 3 in concatenated hit order.

shown.description: Status message accepted for asynchronous display.

enabled.description: Whether dispatcher API tracing is enabled; defaults to true.

shown.description: Alert message accepted for asynchronous display.
Result text accepted for asynchronous display.

rows.description: Table rows as JSON strings. Each string encodes an object with required cells (an array of strings), optional rgb (three integer channels from 0 to 255), and optional guid (an element GUID string).
Number of rows accepted for asynchronous display.

shown.description: True when showing the prompt was accepted for asynchronous dispatch.

coords.description: Packed XYZ coordinates: stride 3, loops concatenated in loopPointCounts order.

loopPointCounts.description: Point count for each loop; sum(values)*3 equals coords length.

loopClosed.description: One closure flag per loop, indexed with loopPointCounts.

loopGuids.description: Packed element identity correspondence: one GUID per loop, indexed with loopPointCounts.

loopElemTypes.description: One ModelerAPI element type per loop, indexed with loopPointCounts.
